subject: Fix typos in comments and rename VALKEY_SANITAIZER_* CMake variables (#2250)
reason: The change only fixes typos in comments (acl.c, db.c, replication.c, valkey-cli.c, zmalloc.c, test .tcl files) and renames the misspelled VALKEY_SANITAIZER_* CMake variables to VALKEY_SANITIZER_*, updated consistently at both the definition (ValkeySetup.cmake) and the use (src/CMakeLists.txt). No runtime code path, command reply, replication behavior, or tool output changes; it is a comment/build-system refactor with no behavior change, so no scenario is needed.
